description: Basic payload with AI video generation tools

payload.query: What AI tools are available for video generation?

retrieved_docs.content: Runway is an AI video generation tool that allows users to create videos from text prompts. It offers features like text-to-video, image-to-video, and video editing capabilities.

Synthesia is a platform that enables users to create AI-generated videos with virtual presenters. Users can input text, and the platform will generate a video with a virtual human presenting the content.
Descript offers AI-powered video editing tools that allow users to edit video by editing text. It includes features like overdub (voice cloning), screen recording, and transcription.

Asana is a work management platform that helps teams organize, track, and manage their work. It offers features like task assignments, project timelines, and custom workflows.
